title: Cupcake with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cupcake case -->
  <path d='M28 62 L32 86 Q33 90 37 90 L63 90 Q67 90 68 86 L72 62 Z' fill='#F4A259'/>
  <!-- case ridges -->
  <path d='M36 62 L38 88' stroke='#FFD08A' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M44 62 L45 89' stroke='#FFD08A' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M56 62 L55 89' stroke='#FFD08A' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M64 62 L62 88' stroke='#FFD08A' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- cake case rim -->
  <rect x='26' y='58' width='48' height='8' rx='4' fill='#E88B3A'/>
  <!-- frosting base -->
  <path d='M24 58 Q24 46 32 42 Q28 34 36 28 Q40 20 50 22 Q60 20 64 28 Q72 34 68 42 Q76 46 76 58 Z' fill='#FFB6D9'/>
  <!-- frosting swirl highlight -->
  <path d='M34 46 Q36 38 44 36 Q50 34 54 38' stroke='#FFD6EA' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 42 Q64 44 66 50' stroke='#FFD6EA' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cherry on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='6' fill='#FF3B5C'/>
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='15.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFA3B5'/>
  <!-- cherry stem -->
  <path d='M50 12 Q54 6 60 7' stroke='#7AC74F' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#5A2D82'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#5A2D82'/>
  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='43.3' cy='48.7' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59.3' cy='48.7' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 58 Q50 66 58 58' stroke='#5A2D82' stroke-width='2.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='55' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#FF8FB8' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='55' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#FF8FB8' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- sprinkles on frosting -->
  <rect x='32' y='38' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#7AC74F' transform='rotate(20 34.5 39)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='34' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#4FC3F7' transform='rotate(-25 62.5 35)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='30' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFD93B' transform='rotate(15 46.5 31)'/>
  <rect x='66' y='48' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFD93B' transform='rotate(-10 68.5 49)'/>
  <rect x='28' y='48' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FF8A65' transform='rotate(30 30.5 49)'/>
  <rect x='52' y='44' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#7AC74F' transform='rotate(-18 54.5 45)'/>
</svg>
